name: React runtime
notes: react-dom looks for __REACT_DEVTOOLS_GLOBAL_HOOK__ and production builds throw "Minified React error #…"; react registers Symbol.for("react.element") (React 19: "react.transitional.element"). Preact's devtools hook is __PREACT_DEVTOOLS__. A script holding React is an app bundle: never lifted, its own React tree would fight the copy's.
